description: This PHP source file defines the PayGradeCurrencyAPI class, which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing pay grade currency data within an HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting pay grade currency records, following the OpenAPI (Swagger) annotations for API documentation. The class interacts with other system components such as models, traits, and repositories to perform CRUD operations and validation.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencyAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller providing CRUD operations for managing pay grade currency records in the HRM system. Supports endpoints for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting currency entries associated with specific pay grades, with validation and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific pay grade currency record identified by payGradeId and currencyId; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all pay grade currency records associated with a specific pay grade, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new pay grade currency record with provided parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing pay grade currency record identified by payGradeId and id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more pay grade currency records based on provided IDs for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Internal method to create or update a PayGradeCurrency entity based on request parameters.
